articles.summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. (NYSE: NOG) (“NOG” or the “Company”) announced today that it plans to issue its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, after the market closes. Additionally, the Company will host a conference call on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Central Time. Those wishing to listen to the conference call may do so via phone or the Company’s webcast. Conference Call and Webcast Details: Date: November 6, 2026 Time: 8:00 a.m. Central Time Dial-In: (833) 461-5787 International Dial-In: (585) 542-9983 Conference ID: 139 482 049 Webcast: Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call Replay Information: A replay of the conference call will be available through November 20, 2026, by dialing: Dial-In: (833) 309-1852 International Dial-In: (929) 828-5978 Conference ID: 139 482 049 An archive of the conference call webcast will also be available on NOG’s website through November 5, 2027.
